name: GCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Vacated by two-time former champion Brandon Simpson before the 2004 revival's own broadcast record opens; commissioner James Oslo ordered a four-way match at the 1 August 2004 pay-per-view WE ALL FALL DOWN to crown a new champion, with Heath Starr and Aroku Murakami claiming the first two of the four match slots across this wing's own surviving broadcasts.

name: GCW Television Championship
epitaph: Named on-air by commentator Tommy Flynn during the 2004 revival's own second broadcast, with a promised update on its status the following week; no update, holder, or further mention survives in this wing's own held record.
